title: Temporal Analysis of Clinical Variant Reclassification (2012-2025): analysis pipeline, processed data, and interactive companion
description:
Open-source analysis pipeline, processed result data, publication figures, and an interactive web companion for the study Temporal Analysis of Clinical Variant Reclassification (2012-2025) (submitted to Genome Medicine).

A longitudinal reprocessing of 3,678,303 ClinVar variants across 148 monthly XML snapshots (November 2012 - July 2025), distinguishing genuine clinical reinterpretation from artifacts of database/schema evolution. ClinVar submitter identities are anonymized to coded labels (Laboratory A, B, C, ...) by submission rank, consistent with the manuscript. The multi-GB intermediate tables are not redistributed here; they are regenerated by the pipeline from the source data.

Source data: the public-domain NCBI ClinVar monthly XML releases (https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pub/clinvar/xml/).
